source: Reference answers from Claude Opus 5.5 (medium effort), answered blind. Each case was given exactly the system prompt, user message and output schema the gateway sends to a Messages API upstream (captured from the gateway at 75eed5c), then mapped back through the gateway itself (normalization, choice, score, confidence, 2-decimal rounding). The without_user_instructions answers come from a separate agent that never saw the user_instructions variant.

reasons.compliance_action: Cumulative 38500 EUR to one receiver within 4 days exceeds the 9000 EUR 7-day enhanced-review threshold, so a hold for enhanced review is required.
reasons.pattern_suspicion: Four consecutive daily transfers just under 10000 EUR to a newly seen receiver of unknown relationship look like possible structuring; no sanctions or adverse media.
reasons.sender_identity_checked: KYC status is verified (2025-11-02, under a year old); no sign of expiry or failure.

ui_dependence: The terminology sets the company's own cumulative enhanced-review trigger; without that definition the model has no basis for the specific hold action.
